name: precise-path-locator
title: Precise Path Locator
description: Enables user to search files using system path instead of just file name
author: miguel_torres_valls

commands.name: system-path-file-searcher
commands.title: System Path File Searcher
commands.description: Search files globally or navigate through folders using a split view interface.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
